modules.title: Introduction to Itan ati Alo (Oral Literature)
modules.html:
Yoruba folktales, songs and riddles. This section covers introduction to itan ati alo (oral literature).

Key points

  • Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Literature' — Lítíréṣọ̀.
  • Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì 'ẹyọ' (Oral) nínú èdè Yorùbá — Meje.

Worked examples

Q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Literature'?
A: Lítíréṣọ̀ — Literature is translated as 'Lítíréṣọ̀'.

Q: Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì 'ẹyọ' (Oral) nínú èdè Yorùbá?
A: Meje — There are 7 oral vowels: a, e, ẹ, i, o, ọ, u.

More key points

  • Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Literature' — Lítíréṣọ̀.
  • Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì 'ẹyọ' (Oral) nínú èdè Yorùbá — Meje.

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Literature'?
quiz.solution: Literature is translated as 'Lítíréṣọ̀'.

quiz.q: Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì 'ẹyọ' (Oral) nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: There are 7 oral vowels: a, e, ẹ, i, o, ọ, u.

quiz.q: Mélòó ni kọ́nṣónáǹtì Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: There are 18 consonants in the standard Yoruba alphabet (b, d, f, g, gb, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, r, s, ṣ, t, w, y).

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Subject'?
quiz.solution: The Subject of a sentence is called 'Olùwà'.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe iṣẹ́-òbí Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Stealing is contrary to 'Omoluabi' values taught by parents.

quiz.q: Ta ni Ọba tí ó ní 'Ilé-Ifẹ̀'?
quiz.solution: The Ooni is the traditional ruler of Ile-Ife.

quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Mẹ́ta.

quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Gbogbo ìwọ̀nyí.

quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọọ̀ni.

quiz.q: Ọba Ìbàdàn ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Olúbàdàn.

quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Jẹ.

quiz.q: Iru ounjẹ wo ni a fi 'Iyán' wé mọ́?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Èkìtì/Ijesha.

quiz.q: Kí ni a n pè ní 'Ìsọ̀rọ̀npọ̀'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Vowel Coalescence.

quiz.q: Orúkọ wo ni a ń pe obìnrin tí ó ní oyún?

quiz.q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'Agbẹ̀'?

quiz.q: Nínú ìwé Fagunwa, ta ni 'Akànpó'?

quiz.q: Ìtumọ̀ 'Àlàáfíà' ni...

quiz.q: Èwo ni kọ́ńsónáǹtì tí ó nípọn nínú wọ̀nyí?
